commits.body:
discover_games walked the date range with a bare urlopen, so a single
transient MLB blip on day 40 of a 180-day backfill threw away every day
already fetched. Every other HTTP caller in the codebase (picks,
scorecard, posting, dm) already goes through the shared retry_urlopen;
download_game_feed had its own inline backoff. This was the last
unprotected fetch on the pull path.

GET is idempotent, so the default policy (3 attempts, linear backoff, no
retry on 4xx) applies unchanged — no idempotent=False needed.

Backfill-only path; the live pick pipeline was never affected.
